statement: let H := fun n : ℕ => ((Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ p ≤ n ∧ (n-p).Prime ∧ n ≤ 3*p ∧ 3*p ≤ 2*n)).card; ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, (((Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n ∧ H n=0 ∧ H (n+2)=0)).card:ℝ) ≤ ε*(X:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 相邻两个偶数都缺中央表示的起点密度趋零
plain_statement.en: Vanishing density of adjacent central misses

brief.zh: 允许任意单点漏失。尝试对相邻两个卷积的共同下尾建立估计，并标明对照的已知中央区间例外集结果。
brief.en: Bound the common lower tail of the two adjacent convolution values. Compare explicitly with existing exceptional-set results before claiming an improvement.
